title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
authors: Benoit Jacob, Skirmantas Kligys, Bo Chen, Menglong Zhu, Matthew Tang, Andrew Howard, Hartwig Adam, Dmitry Kalenichenko
publisher: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
annotation: Makalah dasar kuantisasi INT8 pasca-pelatihan dan quantization-aware training untuk mempercepat inferensi jaringan syaraf pada perangkat komputasi tepi (Edge AI).

title: Designing Network Design Spaces (RegNet)
authors: Ilija Radosavovic, Raj Prateek Kosaraju, Ross Girshick, Kaiming He, Piotr Dollár
publisher: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
annotation: Prinsip perancangan arsitektur jaringan visual ringan dan berkinerja tinggi yang teroptimasi untuk keseimbangan akurasi dan latensi inferensi.

title: A Generalist Agent (Gato)
authors: Scott Reed, Konrad Zolna, Emilio Parisotto, Sergio Gomez Colmenarejo, Alexander Novikov, Gabriel Barth-Maron, Mai Gimenez, Yufeng Zou, Jost Tobias Springenberg, Firas Dunkley, Nimrod Ofir, Nando de Freitas
publisher: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR) / DeepMind
annotation: Model fondasi multimodal terpadu yang memproses teks, citra penglihatan, dan tindakan motorik robotik dalam satu arsitektur Transformer terpadu (Embodied AI perspective).

title: Multimodal Machine Learning: A Survey and Taxonomy
authors: Tadas Baltrušaitis, Chaitanya Ahuja, Louis-Philippe Morency
publisher: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
annotation: Tinjauan komprehensif mengenai tantangan praktis implementasi fusi multimodal, penanganan data hilang (missing data), dan ketidakpastian sensor.
